findings.title: Titles that look like ids are shadowed by the id lookup
findings.why: `find` tries `get(key)` before the title map, and ids are `task-N`. A task titled `task-1` can't be addressed by its title once a task with id `task-1` exists. `complete`, `rename` and `remove` then change or delete the other task. The `TaskList` doc comment documents this, but nothing stops such a title from being created.
